comparison.objective: Use an insulated fuse puller to rock a target cartridge fuse from its clips and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool grasping, target selection, jaw clamping, sequential end-by-end levering, and controlled placement.
comparison.success_condition: Only F2 is removed while held by the puller and comes to rest in the tray; neighboring fuses remain undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Sequential levering with a dedicated puller tests extraction from spring clips. The candidate tests insertion-like transfer over a continuously supported rail/jig junction and preservation of all free rolling elements.
